_comment: Where the briefing looks for news. Edit this file to add or remove sources — no code changes needed. Every feed URL here was checked and returned recent, valid items. If you add one, run: npm run check-sources
_aiKeywordsNote: Used to filter sources where filterForAI is true. A story is kept if its title or description mentions any of these.

hackernews._comment: Searched via the public Hacker News (Algolia) API. Results are filtered to AI-related items only.
hackernews._minPointsComment: Ignore Hacker News posts below this score, to cut low-quality noise.

feeds.name: TechCrunch AI
feeds._comment: Business and funding news about AI companies.

feeds.name: MIT Technology Review AI
feeds._comment: How AI is affecting industries and society.

feeds.name: BBC Technology
feeds._comment: General tech news, so it is filtered down to AI stories only.

feeds.name: Product Hunt
feeds._comment: Tracks new product launches. Filtered down to AI launches only. Wider lookback than other sources (48h, not 24h) because the AI-relevant slice of any single day's launches is small — this gives the briefing enough genuine candidates to pick from for the 'New launches' section.
